versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ntriq-x402-code-review-batch.
- Batch review up to 500 code snippets per request.
- Flat $15.00 USDC per batch via x402 protocol (Base mainnet, EIP-3009 gasless).
- 100% local inference processing on Mac Mini.
- Supports review focus options: security, performance, quality, or all.
- Simple JSON API with endpoint and example provided.
